end.summary:
Discussed how festivals vary across regions and may be celebrated in different ways.
Kavya identified Diwali practices including diyas, rangoli, new clothes, and gujiya.
Linked harvest festivals with the time when crops are ready for cutting.
Compared Kerala and Assam harvest festivals; food differences were suggested, but teach-back was not completed.
end.parentNote: Kavya practised noticing that festivals can have shared purposes but different customs, foods, and activities in different regions. They connected harvest festivals with crops being ready and explained that people give thanks for the harvest. Kavya mixed up the season for harvest festivals and suggested summer; this was not corrected later in the lesson. At home, ask Kavya to compare two festivals using “same” and “different” for their food, clothes, or activities.
